name: Rue des Gestes — étape 1 · serrer, pencher, tendre
note: Tiered verb place. -er LEFT (neighbours shaking hands with a hard squeeze, man on a stepladder leaning out for a falling pen, woman shaking a rug with a cuckoo flying out on the balcony, man trembling at a dangling spider at the upper window, jittery old lady shaking a hand bell on the roof terrace), -ir/-re RIGHT (girl holding out a carrot to a donkey). Forward = far lane; back = near cobbles to the square.
